name_en: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) – Supplementary Nutrition at Anganwadi
department: Integrated Child Development Services, Department of Social Welfare, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: At the Anganwadi centre, young children, pregnant women and new mothers get free extra food (a nutrition flour mix) for 300 days a year. Children aged 2 to 5 also get a hot meal, pre-school learning and health check-ups. Out-of-school girls aged 11 to 14 can get the food mix too.

other: Children aged 6 months to about 6 years.
Pregnant women and mothers who are feeding a baby.

how_to_apply: Go to your nearest Anganwadi centre and register your child or your pregnancy.

evidence.quote: Welcome to Department of Integrated Child Development Services Government of Tamilnadu.
